name: code-canopy
description: Plan and execute engineering goals with small, safe agent trees.

interface.longDescription: CodeCanopy turns an engineering requirement into a reviewed tree of specialist and worker agents, isolates Git writes, and keeps integration and final verification with one lead.
defaultPrompt: Use $code-canopy to plan this engineering goal as a bounded agent tree.
Use $code-canopy to implement this feature with isolated worktrees and verification.
Use $code-canopy to choose the smallest safe engineering team for this task.
